title: Regine Velasquez, more celebs echo concern over 'scarred' Sierra Madre

blocks.text: Several celebrities including Regine Velasquez, Winwyn Marquez and Angelica Panganiban lamented the “severely scarred and deforested” state of the Sierra Madre, joining calls for the government to address the matter. Dubbed the “Great Wall of Luzon,” the Sierra Madre mountain range serves as the country’s natural shield against typhoons coming from the Pacific Ocean, weakening strong winds and helping reduce their impact on the lowlands. The celebrities expressed their dismay through the comments section of a post by Iskolar ng Bayan, a social media platform managed by University of the Philippines alumni.
